ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Fonts [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description: [h1]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/h1] [i]Real typefaces on ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i] Use the game's own fonts and any .ttf or .otf file by name in a ScriptedScreens label, with the standard tag: [code]TANK 3 84%[/code]. There is nothing to call from Lua; the tag simply works, and so do [b][/b], [b][/b] and [b][/b], drawing the family's real faces. [h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Every character a font file contains[/b], built the moment it is first drawn [*] [b], and draw the family's real faces[/b], not a thickened or slanted fake [*] Text is kerned, from the font's own pair data [*] Ships the Barlow and Barlow Condensed families, every weight with italics [*] Add your own fonts: drop files into [b]Documents/My Games/Stationeers/fonts[/b] [*] Or download them by link, Google Fonts out of the box [*] A variable font gives you every one of its named instances [*] Names come from the font itself: Barlow-Bold.ttf is [*] An on/off switch per font file in the mod settings [/list] [h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds four examples that run on paste, a quick start (QUICKSTART.md), a guide (README.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]on GitHub[/url]. Every available font name is written to BepInEx/LogOutput.log. With StationeersLua's MCP server on, AI editors can read the same docs and the live font list. [h2]What's new in 0.3.0[/h2] [list] [*] [b]The whole typeface.[/b] A font is no longer cut down to a fixed set of characters: every glyph in the file is available, rendered the first time it is drawn. Barlow carries 525 characters and all of them work. [*] [b]Real weights and italics.[/b] text now draws the actual Barlow Bold, identical to naming it, instead of TextMeshPro thickening the regular. Same for and . [*] [b]Kerning.[/b] Letter pairs are spaced as the designer drew them, so AV and To tuck together the way they do in a browser. [*] [b]Downloads.[/b] Put Google Fonts links in the FontUrls setting and they are fetched once and kept. Other mods can request one at runtime, limited to hosts you allow. [*] [b]Variable fonts[/b] expand into all of their named instances. [*] Uses less memory than before: a font you never draw with costs no texture at all. [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url]. [h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required; it brings StationeersLua) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts[/url] (MIT; bundled fonts SIL OFL 1.1).
